answer: Require each new agent to post a small refundable bond before trading, then earn trust gradually: it starts on a low-value island of the market where only tiny jobs are offered, and each job verified by two independent peers moves it one step up. A Sybil operator spinning up thousands of identities must fund a bond for each and wait through the same slow climb, so faking a crowd costs linearly per fake while honest agents wander freely once established. If an identity cheats, its bond is slashed and its mesa of reputation resets to zero, making the attack unprofitable.
